numerology.system: Vedic-Chaldean Numerology with Jyotish Planet Mapping
numerology.description: Numerology is the science of numbers and their cosmic vibrations. In Vedic tradition, each number 1-9 corresponds to a graha (planet), creating a bridge between numerology and Jyotish. The Chaldean system is preferred for name analysis as it assigns values based on sound vibration rather than alphabetical order.

1.life_lesson: Learning to lead without dominating, to shine without overshadowing others
1.spiritual_significance: The Atman — the individual soul expressing divine will
1.vedic_mantra: Om Hraam Hreem Hraum Sah Suryaya Namah

2.life_lesson: Learning to balance sensitivity with inner strength, to cooperate without losing identity
2.spiritual_significance: Manas — the mind reflecting the light of consciousness
2.vedic_mantra: Om Shraam Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah

3.life_lesson: Learning to focus creative energy, to teach through example rather than sermon
3.spiritual_significance: Guru Tattva — the principle of divine wisdom and grace
3.vedic_mantra: Om Graam Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah

4.life_lesson: Learning to build stable foundations while embracing change, finding order in chaos
4.spiritual_significance: Maya — the illusion that drives worldly experience and ultimate awakening
4.vedic_mantra: Om Bhraam Bhreem Bhraum Sah Rahave Namah

5.life_lesson: Learning to channel mental energy into depth rather than breadth, to commit rather than scatter
5.spiritual_significance: Buddhi — the discriminating intellect that bridges matter and spirit
5.vedic_mantra: Om Braam Breem Braum Sah Budhaya Namah

6.life_lesson: Learning to love without possessing, to beautify without vanity, to serve without martyrdom
6.spiritual_significance: Prema — divine love expressing through earthly beauty and relationships
6.vedic_mantra: Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah

7.life_lesson: Learning to bridge the spiritual and material worlds, to share insights without isolation
7.spiritual_significance: Moksha — liberation through knowledge, the tail of the cosmic serpent releasing attachment
7.vedic_mantra: Om Sraam Sreem Sraum Sah Ketave Namah

8.life_lesson: Learning that limitations are teachers, that true power comes through patience and righteous action
8.spiritual_significance: Karma — the cosmic law of cause and effect, the great equalizer and teacher
8.vedic_mantra: Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaischaraya Namah

9.master_of: courage, energy, and completing the cycle of experience
9.life_lesson: Learning to channel martial energy constructively, to fight for justice rather than domination
9.spiritual_significance: Shakti — the dynamic cosmic energy that destroys ignorance and protects dharma
9.vedic_mantra: Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namah

11.title: The Spiritual Messenger
11.significance: Heightened Moon energy with spiritual awakening potential. The individual channels cosmic messages and serves as a bridge between the material and spiritual worlds.
11.planet_amplification: Double Sun vibration channeled through Moon — illuminating the subconscious mind
11.famous_pattern: Prophets, spiritual leaders, artists with divine inspiration
11.karmic_duty: To inspire and uplift humanity through spiritual insight and creative expression

22.title: The Master Builder
22.significance: Amplified Rahu energy capable of building lasting structures that serve humanity. Combines the vision of 11 with practical ability to manifest in the material world.
22.planet_amplification: Double Moon vibration channeled through Rahu — dreams made manifest on a grand scale
challenges: tendency to manipulate for the greater good
22.famous_pattern: Empire builders, architects of institutions, visionary entrepreneurs
22.karmic_duty: To build enduring structures and systems that benefit humanity across generations

33.title: The Master Teacher
33.significance: Elevated Venus energy expressing universal love and wisdom. The rarest master number, representing the Christ/Buddha consciousness of selfless service.
33.planet_amplification: Double Jupiter vibration channeled through Venus — divine wisdom expressed through unconditional love
challenges: self-sacrifice to the point of self-destruction
33.famous_pattern: Great spiritual teachers, healers, those who sacrifice for humanity
33.karmic_duty: To embody and teach unconditional love, healing the world through compassion and example

44.title: The Master Healer
44.significance: Double Rahu vibration channeled through Saturn — mastering the material world to serve spiritual purposes. Extremely rare and demanding vibration.
44.planet_amplification: Rahu-Saturn axis amplified — ability to transform karmic debts into spiritual gold
challenges: encounters with the darkest aspects of human nature
44.famous_pattern: Transformational leaders who rise from great adversity
44.karmic_duty: To heal through personal transformation, showing others that suffering can be transmuted into wisdom

psychic_number.calculation: Single digit sum of birth day (e.g., born on 28th: 2+8=10, 1+0=1)
psychic_number.significance: Reveals inner nature, how you see yourself, personal desires and approach to life
psychic_number.jyotish_correlation: Similar to Lagna (Ascendant) — your personality filter

destiny_number.calculation: Single digit sum of full birth date (day+month+year)
destiny_number.significance: Reveals life purpose, what the world sees, karmic path and opportunities
destiny_number.jyotish_correlation: Similar to Moon sign — your destined emotional and life path

name_number.calculation: Single digit sum of full name using letter-number mapping (Chaldean preferred)
name_number.significance: Reveals social identity, how others perceive you, professional success vibration
name_number.most_active_period: Active throughout life, can be modified by changing name spelling
name_number.jyotish_correlation: Similar to 10th house — your public image and worldly expression

soul_urge_number.calculation: Single digit sum of all vowels in full birth name
soul_urge_number.significance: Reveals innermost desires, what truly motivates the soul
soul_urge_number.jyotish_correlation: Similar to Atmakaraka — the soul's deepest longing

personality_number.calculation: Single digit sum of all consonants in full birth name
personality_number.significance: Reveals outer personality, first impression on others
personality_number.jyotish_correlation: Similar to Arudha Lagna — the projected image

lo_shu_grid.description: The Lo Shu grid is a 3x3 magic square from ancient Chinese numerology adopted into Vedic practice. Numbers from the birth date are placed in the grid to reveal strengths and missing elements.

mental.present: Strong thinker, good memory, analytical mind
mental.absent: May rely more on feelings than logic

emotional.meaning: Feelings, intuition, spiritual awareness, inner life
emotional.present: Emotionally balanced, strong intuition, spiritual depth

practical.meaning: Physical ability, material matters, creativity, action
practical.present: Practical, good with hands, materially capable
practical.absent: May struggle with practical affairs and material goals

thought.present: Good planner, organized thinker, follows through on ideas

action.present: Action-oriented, good at execution and finishing projects

determination.meaning: Strong willpower and persistence. Never gives up. Can achieve anything through sheer determination.

compassion.meaning: Emotional sensitivity and empathy. Deep understanding of human nature. Natural healer and counselor.

intellect.meaning: Brilliant mind with exceptional mental clarity. Strong memory, quick understanding, creative thinking.

spirituality.meaning: Deep spiritual awareness and serenity. Inner peace, philosophical nature, connection to higher realms.

planner.meaning: Organized thinking, excellent at planning and strategy. Good memory and sequential processing.

willpower.meaning: Exceptional patience and willpower. Can endure any hardship. Persistent effort over long periods.

activity.meaning: High energy and physical activity. Dynamic, action-oriented, restless until goals are achieved.

practical_action.meaning: Strong practical abilities. Excellent at implementing ideas and working with hands.

emotional_balance.meaning: Emotional stability and balance. Well-centered personality with good coping skills.

creative_force.meaning: Powerful creative energy. Artistic talent, imagination, ability to manifest visions.

frustration.meaning: Lack of patience, prone to frustration and short temper. Difficulty with sustained effort.
frustration.remedy: Practice meditation, develop patience through Saturn-related remedies

disappointment.meaning: Repeated setbacks and disappointments. Difficulty learning from past experiences.
disappointment.remedy: Develop emotional resilience, practice gratitude, strengthen Moon

loneliness.meaning: Feels isolated and disconnected. Difficulty maintaining close relationships.
loneliness.remedy: Build community connections, volunteer service, strengthen Sun and Mars

sensitivity.meaning: Emotional coldness or inability to connect with feelings of others.
sensitivity.remedy: Practice empathy exercises, connect with nature, strengthen Moon and Ketu

confusion.meaning: Scattered thinking, poor memory, difficulty with analysis and decision-making.
confusion.remedy: Mental exercises, study discipline, strengthen Mercury and Rahu

impracticality.meaning: Difficulty with material affairs, money management, and practical tasks.
impracticality.remedy: Develop routine, practical skills, strengthen Saturn and Sun

indecision.meaning: Difficulty making decisions and taking practical action on ideas.
indecision.remedy: Practice decisiveness, take small risks daily, strengthen Sun and Rahu

aimlessness.meaning: Lack of direction, difficulty setting and achieving goals.
aimlessness.remedy: Set clear intentions, work with mentor/guru, strengthen Jupiter

1.meaning: New beginnings, fresh starts, independence. Plant seeds for the 9-year cycle. Take initiative, start new projects. This is the year to be bold and self-reliant.
1.advice: Start something new. Be assertive. Do not wait for others.
1.avoid: Depending on others, clinging to the past, hesitation

2.meaning: Patience, cooperation, relationships. Nurture what was started in Year 1. Form partnerships, develop diplomacy. Seeds planted need time to grow.
2.advice: Be patient. Cooperate. Focus on relationships and details.

3.meaning: Creativity, self-expression, social expansion. Joy and communication. Year of fun, socializing, and expressing your creative talents.
3.advice: Express yourself. Create. Socialize. Expand your network.

4.meaning: Hard work, foundations, discipline. Build structures for the future. Year of effort, practical matters, and laying groundwork.
4.advice: Work hard. Build. Organize. Pay attention to details.

5.meaning: Change, freedom, adventure. Expect the unexpected. Year of travel, variety, and major life changes. Adaptability is key.
5.advice: Embrace change. Travel. Try new things. Be flexible.

6.meaning: Responsibility, family, home. Service to others. Year focused on domestic matters, love relationships, and taking on responsibilities.
6.advice: Focus on home and family. Accept responsibilities. Beautify your surroundings.

7.meaning: Introspection, spirituality, wisdom. Inner growth and analysis. Year for study, research, meditation, and deep self-reflection.
7.advice: Go within. Study. Meditate. Seek wisdom over action.

8.meaning: Power, abundance, achievement. Material rewards for past efforts. Year of recognition, financial gains, and karmic returns.
8.advice: Focus on career and finances. Claim your power. Think big.

9.meaning: Completion, endings, transformation. Let go and prepare for renewal. Year of tying loose ends, philanthropy, and clearing the way for a new cycle.
9.advice: Let go of what no longer serves you. Give back. Complete unfinished business.

numerology.personal_month_calculation: Add personal year number + calendar month number, reduce to single digit
numerology.personal_day_calculation: Add personal month number + calendar day number, reduce to single digit

pinnacle_cycles.description: Four pinnacle cycles divide life into major phases, each ruled by a number derived from the birth date

first_pinnacle.duration: Birth to age 36 minus life path number

challenge_numbers.description: Challenge numbers reveal obstacles to overcome during each pinnacle period
challenge_numbers.first_challenge: Absolute difference of birth month and birth day digits
challenge_numbers.second_challenge: Absolute difference of birth day and birth year digits
challenge_numbers.third_challenge: Absolute difference of first and second challenge
challenge_numbers.fourth_challenge: Absolute difference of birth month and birth year digits
